title: Chapter 557
text:
At the same time, the Six Nations were also attacked by the Dark-star spaceships. Without Han Xiao's base, the city was ravaged by cannon fire, and the streets were filled with charred bodies.

The tanks opened fire at the spaceships in the sky, and the cannonballs exploded on the shields of the spaceships. However, even the armor-piercing bullets could not penetrate the shields of the galactic technology and could only cause some energy ripples. The Dark-star spaceships were not affected, and they left behind clouds of black smoke wherever they passed. They then turned to fire at the tanks.

The cannonballs easily tore through the armor of the tanks and exploded from the inside, wiping out the tanks one after another.

The difference in their civilization level was too great, and the Six Nations did not have the ability to resist.

However, the fighter jets continued to attack the Dark-star spaceships and were shot down one after another. The other fighter jets continued to charge forward like moths to a flame. This was a one-sided battle, but not a single fighter jet turned around and fled.

Even though they knew that it was impossible to break through the defenses of the spaceships, the fighter jets still stubbornly launched suicide attacks.

The aliens wanted to destroy the entire planet, and there was no way out no matter where they fled. The Mutation Disaster seemed to have awakened the tenacity of the people of Blue Star, and the soldiers of the Six Nations defended their home without fear of death.

Even though they knew that this was akin to a mantis trying to stop a chariot, they still had to resist with all their might.

The upper echelons of the Six Nations looked at the Dark-star spaceships wreaking havoc in the city and saw the number of casualties continue to rise, and they felt a sense of sorrow from the bottom of their hearts.

They had experienced countless wars in the Old Era and were already used to it. However, this was the first time they had encountered a battle where they had no choice but to sacrifice the lives of their soldiers and send them to their deaths while the enemy remained unharmed.

The upper echelons of the Six Nations all had gloomy expressions, and they clenched their fists so tightly that their knuckles turned white. In the past few months, they had felt the sorrow of their civilization falling behind more than once. It was like a child being casually pinched by an adult, and their resistance was futile.

Right at this moment, the reinforcements from the Sanctuary arrived. The mercenaries had brought many Inhumans, and while there were many enemy spaceships, a portion of them were held back and alleviated the crisis of the Six Nations slightly.

"Black Star's men are here." The upper echelons of the Six Nations loosened their fists.

Thankfully, there is someone like Black Star on this weak planet of ours.

Only then would we have the ability to retaliate.

…

In the sky above the sanctuary, the number of Dark-star assault spaceships had increased by several times. Even more concentrated artillery fire landed on the city shield of the base, causing it to tremble and rumble continuously. With Nagojin's troops harassing them from the side, they were unable to break through the shield with concentrated fire.

Nagojin, in particular, did not need to use any other means to deal with such small assault ships in the atmosphere. He just needed to blast through the shields of the spaceships and destroy them with just a few punches.

His face was filled with worry as he looked at Han Xiao's battlefield from time to time. He had seen Degulish and the other two appear, and how could he not know that the enemy's goal was to ambush Black Star.

Nagojin originally wanted to turn around and support Han Xiao, but Black Star told him not to do anything through the mech communicator. He also said that he would hold back the three Calamities while Nagojin continued to deal with the assault ship.

This is crazy!

Nagojin did not dare to imagine how Han Xiao was going to hold back the three Calamities. Even if it was him, he would be dead for sure!

Only when Han Xiao said that he would only call for him if he could not hold on anymore did Nagojin give up on the idea of going over to support him. Previously, he had seen Han Xiao's transactions with the upper echelons and knew that this mercenary was very realistic. He would definitely not do something that would definitely kill him. He definitely had confidence in himself, so he could only suppress his worry — even if he did not understand how Han Xiao was going to hold back the three Calamities.

Inside the shield, countless residents looked up in fear at the shield that seemed like it would collapse at any moment. This was the last barrier to protect them, and everyone was trembling in fear. They could not help but pray.

A portion of the assault ships sent in ground troops, preparing to pass through the shield from underground. With the charge of hundreds of thousands of players, the ground troops sent in by Dark-star were instantly drowned in the sea of people, not even causing a ripple.

With hundreds of thousands of Supers, and all of them undying, this kind of strength caused Dark-star to give up on the ground attack. Dark-star's ground troops hugged the hatch tightly and refused to leave the ship. Damn it, it's so good to stay in the sky. I don't want to go down and die.

Dark-star's troops could not be bothered to deal with these undying enemies and focused on attacking the city. Only a small portion of the long-range players were able to attack the spaceships in the sky. The majority of the players could only put their hands on their hips and watch helplessly. Those who had nothing to do had already turned on the recording function.

However, this portion of players quickly found something to do and turned to look at Han Xiao's battlefield.

…

Boom! Boom!

Boom! Degulish's fist pierced through a mechanical shield soldier of the G-1 Steel Army, and his Pugilist flames shot out, destroying dozens of mechanical constructs around him.

Terry spun like a top, and his killing range was more than a hundred meters in diameter. All the mechanical soldiers within this range were sliced apart.

With his two companions suppressing the firepower, Ashes exploded with even greater killing power. The black tide swept through the ground like an ocean, swallowing groups of mechanical soldiers in a large area. He alone destroyed two thousand mechanical soldiers.

The combined attack of three Calamity Grade Supers had a shocking destructive power. In just a short while, the Mech Legion had lost a third of its members.

"My Mech Legion is barely enough to deal with three Calamity Grade Supers." Han Xiao's expression was heavy.

This degree of loss was within his expectations. Calamity Grade Supers were not easy to deal with, and with his current mechanical capabilities, he would need to sacrifice tens of thousands of cannon fodder to whittle down the energy of an ordinary Calamity Grade Supers. This also depended on the opponent's ability. If it was like Anur, who had a large area of effect, it would be even more difficult to deal with.

Thankfully, Ashes's Esper Ability was more suited for dealing with carbon-based life forms. While he had both offense and defense, his energy consumption was also high. Degulish was a Pugilist, and he had high burst power and endurance, but he did not have an area of effect. Terry was a Mechanical Pugilist, and the Mech Legion was still able to suppress them, making the three of them take a longer time to reach him.

However, after dodging for a while, Han Xiao was still caught in the crossfire. Surrounded by close combat, he was forced into a passive position.

Degulish and Terry were both proficient in close combat, and their attacks were like a storm. Han Xiao could only defend, and his shield was frequently shattered. His Hovering Shield Shuttle was cut in half, and his mechanical arm was also hammered into scrap metal. Relying on his mechanical suit and his physical body to tank, his health dropped bit by bit.

With the focus fire of the Mech Legion, Ashes had no choice but to control the black tide to surround everyone and block the attacks, allowing his two teammates to focus on Han Xiao.

The black tide separated the Mech Legion from Han Xiao, with the Mech Legion on the outside and Han Xiao on the inside. The Mech Legion wanted to charge through the black tide to help Han Xiao, but they were all blocked by Ashes. As the Mech Legion was reduced by a third, the pressure on him was greatly reduced, and he even had the time to occasionally attack Han Xiao.

Only eight of the Oathkeepers remained by Han Xiao's side, assisting him in battle. However, they were destroyed one after another. The Oathkeepers were elite machines, and under the buffs of Han Xiao, they had the ability to fight against Grade B Supers. However, their opponents this time were Calamity Grade Supers, and three of them at that!

Bang!

The abdomen of the last Oathkeeper was shattered by Degulish's kick, and its parts fell to the ground like intestines. Following which, Degulish grabbed its head and pulled it out forcefully. In an instant, oil splattered everywhere, and the neck was still connected to some tendon-like wires.

"What other helpers do you have? Call them all out." Degulish threw the head of the Oathkeeper away, his voice filled with killing intent and rage.

The eight Oathkeepers all fell, and Han Xiao half knelt on the ground, coughing non-stop. There were many damaged parts of the mech, and sparks were leaking out.

Everyone was surrounded by the black tide, and the Mech Legion were all blocked outside, constantly being destroyed by Ashes.

Han Xiao took a deep breath and checked his status. His HP was still around 82%, but his energy had just recovered. The mech had blocked even more damage, and its durability was only left with 8%.

[Indestructible Fortitude] had been triggered, reducing even more damage. However, only damage to the body could trigger [Energy Absorption].

The Void Dragon Mech was a good item, and he had used it for a long time. Even now, it could still keep up with his level. Han Xiao did not want to lose this mech. Seeing that the durability of the mech was almost depleted, Han Xiao hurriedly kept the mech, exposing his body to the three Calamity Grade Supers.

Only then were the three of them able to see Han Xiao's face.

"You're finally willing to come out from this shell." Ashes's lips curled up.

A Mechanic giving up on the mech and exposing his body meant that he had been forced into a dead end.

"Stop talking nonsense and quickly kill him."

Terry's face was filled with impatience. He shook the metal piece, and it turned into a hard blade with energy wrapped around it.

At this moment, Han Xiao straightened his body, and there was not much nervousness on his face. This calm expression made Degulish and Ashes frown.

"Don't be too happy. The battle has only just begun!"

As he spoke, Han Xiao raised his foot and stomped down.

Hum!

Endless Mechanical Force spread out from where his foot landed like a gigantic lightning spider web, easily passing through the black tide and covering the entire battlefield.

The abandoned parts on the ground were connected by electric snakes, making sizzling noises.

The next moment, countless abandoned parts floated into the air, and the distorted metal pieces regained their shape under the effect of the Mechanical Force field. They quickly reassembled and turned back into their original mechanical soldiers. More than half of the one-third of the Mech Legion had been recovered.

Within the black tide, the eight Oathkeepers stood up once more. One of the Oathkeepers twisted the head that it had just installed, and with a click, it adjusted its position.

Waste Modification!

The destroyed mech was instantly pulled back up!

Looking at the eight Oathkeepers surrounding Han Xiao, Degulish's face instantly turned dark.

"This fellow really has a lot of tricks up his sleeve!" Terry clicked his tongue.

"That's useless. Without the mech, he's dead for sure," Degulish said angrily.

Ashes coldly snorted. With the number of his army recovered, the pressure on him increased, and he could not divert his attention to deal with Han Xiao. He could only focus on dealing with the Mech Legion and leave Han Xiao to his two teammates.

Han Xiao's face turned slightly pale. Using [Waste Modification] on such a large scale consumed a terrifying amount of energy, and he had lost more than half of his maximum energy.

The energy consumption of this skill depended on the area it covered and the number of mechs in the area. At the same time, there was a coefficient of 0x, where x was a variable. After multiplying it, it would be the exact amount of energy consumed. The higher one's level was, the smaller this coefficient would be. This meant that the higher one's level was, the lower the energy consumption of [Waste Modification] would be.

Boom boom boom!

The next second, Degulish and Terry charged forward once more, unleashing a torrential barrage of attacks. The battle began once more!

Their fists landed heavily on their bodies time and time again, and the metal blades slashed open wounds on their bodies.

Without the bonuses of the mech, Han Xiao became even more passive. He was constantly struck, and blood spurted out from his mouth. It looked as though he was at the end of the road. The attacks of the two Calamity Grade Supers were extremely powerful, and they dealt at least a few thousand damage every second on Han Xiao's body.

After fighting to his heart's content for a long time, Degulish finally realized that something was wrong.

Wait a minute!

This fellow had spurted out a few liters of blood, so how was he still so lively?

If Degulish could see Han Xiao's attributes, he would have noticed that Han Xiao's HP and MP bars were constantly increasing and decreasing. It looked rather playful, and his HP had never dropped below half.

He looked like he was in a sorry state, but in truth, he was as steady as an old dog, not panicking at all!

Every second dealt a few thousand damage, and the amount of energy he converted to energy was also a lot. Degulish and Terry's damage was very high, but it could not keep up with his health regeneration.

Han Xiao was secretly relieved. Only through actual combat did he know how tenacious his vitality was. He did not even need to use the Aurora Character Summon Card that he had prepared.

[Intermediate Cell Proliferation Control].

[Intermediate Energy Absorption].

These two Molding Talents were simply too powerful!

Thank you, Fu Ding, bro!

Although it was stable, it still hurt to be beaten up. However, compared to the pain he had experienced during his Race Evolution, this bit of pain was a form of enjoyment.

Degulish fought for a long time, his expression constantly changing, from ferocious to shocked, from shocked to shocked, and from shocked to dumbfounded.

No matter how much they increased their strength, causing Black Star to spurt out blood, the other party did not show any signs of being heavily injured. He could still run, jump, and even open his mouth.

Not only Degulish, but even Terry was dumbfounded.

F * ck, what was wrong with this person?

Why couldn't he be beaten to death?

Peng!

Another attack, and Han Xiao was sent flying, creating a large crater in the ground. Degulish and Terry did not continue to chase after him. Instead, they stood far away, looking at Han Xiao in shock.

"Hm? Why aren't you fighting anymore? "

Wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, Han Xiao stood up, his body covered in blood. He patted the dust off his body and chuckled.

"That's it? I haven't had enough fun yet. Put in more strength. Did you guys not drink milk? "

Ashes' pupils constricted, and his face was filled with disbelief. This scene had awakened a distant memory. The first time he had fought with Han Xiao on Floating Dragon Island, Han Xiao had displayed an extremely powerful recovery ability, forcing him to retreat.

At that time, Ashes had thought that Han Xiao's recovery ability had a limit, and as long as he was strong enough, he would definitely be able to kill the other party. This was what he had thought until not too long ago.

However, Han Xiao had used his physical body to take on two Calamity Grade Supers who were going all out, and even the ground had caved in a few meters from the shockwaves, forming a large crater. However, he was still as lively as ever.

At this moment, Ashes was shaken.

Could it be that he was wrong, and this fellow's recovery ability really had no limit?

Wouldn't that mean … no one would be able to kill this monster?

Just as the three of them were in shock, rumbling footsteps could be heard from not too far away. It was as though an army of hundreds of thousands was marching, and even the ground was trembling.

Hundreds of thousands of players were charging toward Han Xiao's battlefield. They were unable to deal with the spaceships in the sky, so they had come over to join in the fun.

While they were only low-grade Supers, there were hundreds of thousands of them. Furthermore, many of them had broken through the level 60 barrier and obtained Race Evolution.

"Courting death. I'll deal with this group of people. You guys think of a way to kill Black Star."

Ashes kept the shock in his heart, and a cold light flashed in his eyes. He was prepared to destroy these hundreds of thousands of people.

Way? What way?

Degulish clenched his teeth, opened his communicator, and gave an order to the temporary commander of the fleet.

"Activate the main cannon of the mothership!"

"Your Excellency, where should we attack?"

"Attack Black Star for me!"

Not too far away, Han Xiao's despicable smile froze on his face.
